text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...I am convinced. That your brilliance 
as athletes will ignite the passion that 
moves countless hearts."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I too will give my best... No, I shall 
give 120%! Let us create the ultimate 
entertainment together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching <chrname>'s training seemed to set her 
soul ablaze with fiery passion...!
